title: Cash payment evidence domain

decision.boundary: Record immutable caller-supplied evidence that cash was received against one exact FOOD-005E physical-order version. This is evidence only and does not create completed-sale, paid-in-full, fulfillment, inventory, accounting or rewards authority.
reason: FOOD-005E exposes only requested and cancelled physical-order truth.
FOOD-005F deliberately models electronic processor confirmation only.
FOOD-005F confirmed amount may differ from merchandise subtotal and does not establish paid-in-full truth.
Authoritative final payable total, tax, delivery fee, discount, tip and fulfillment-completion truth remain unresolved.
Cash therefore requires its own bounded evidence family before any later payment reconciliation or sale-completion service can reason across payment channels.
decision.pos: POS-lite remains application/service behavior over canonical records. FOOD-005I does not create a POS UI or sale ledger.
decision.saleCompletion: Deferred. Cash evidence does not establish a completed sale.
decision.paymentReconciliation: Deferred. A later trusted layer may combine authoritative payable-total truth with electronic and cash payment evidence.
decision.accounting: Deferred. Cash evidence is not revenue recognition, bookkeeping, deposit, settlement or ledger truth.
decision.fulfillment: Deferred. Cash evidence confers no scheduling, preparation, readiness, dispatch, delivery or handoff authority.
decision.inventory: Deferred. Cash evidence causes no inventory movement.
decision.feedback: Deferred. Customer feedback and verified-purchase semantics require later purchase/completion truth.
decision.demand: Deferred. Requested, paid and fulfilled demand remain distinct observations.
decision.rewards: Deferred. Cash evidence grants no loyalty, referral or rewards entitlement.

version.meaning: One immutable evidence occurrence. Corrections/reversals are separate future evidence rather than mutation.

order.snapshot: Copies exact merchandiseSubtotal only as historical context

evidence.trustedMeaning: Caller asserts that an external/manual trusted process observed cash receipt. Pure domain cannot authenticate the assertion.

invariants: merchandiseSubtotal is historical order context only
cash evidence must not mutate or reprice FOOD-005E
cancelled-order evidence occurrence does not revive the order
cash and electronic payment evidence remain distinct canonical source families
pure domain cannot establish global receipt-reference uniqueness or duplicate prevention

future.paymentReconciliation: A trusted future service may combine exact order truth, authoritative final payable total and one or more trusted payment evidence families.
future.saleCompletion: Requires separate fulfillment/commercial truth and must not be inferred from FOOD-005I.
future.cashPersistence: Repository/service layer must later enforce duplicate prevention and operational identity rules.
future.pos: A later POS/admin surface may create trusted cash evidence but is outside this pure domain.
